question: Which of the following departments under the Ministry of Finance has launched the scheme "Vivad se Vishwas II" — (Contractual Disputes) to effectively settle the pending contractual disputes of government and government undertakings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Expenditure**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Department of Expenditure** under the Ministry of Finance has launched the scheme "Vivad se Vishwas II" — (Contractual Disputes) to effectively settle the pending contractual disputes of government and government undertakings.
 
• The scheme aims to provide a faster and more efficient resolution mechanism for disputes, thereby reducing litigation and promoting ease of doing business.
 
• It is a part of the government's efforts to streamline processes and ensure timely completion of projects and contracts.
 
• The scheme is expected to benefit both the government and the contractors by reducing the time and costs associated with prolonged litigation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Finance comprises several departments, including the Department of Economic Affairs, Department of Expenditure, Department of Financial Services, and Department of Revenue.
 
• The **Department of Expenditure** is responsible for overseeing the public financial management system in the Central Government and matters connected with state finances.
 
• It also oversees the implementation of recommendations made by the Finance Commission and the Central Pay Commission.
 
• The "Vivad se Vishwas II" scheme is an extension of the "Vivad se Vishwas I" scheme, which focused on resolving direct tax disputes.
